create_habitat_dataset: create a Habitat dataset instance with a specified scene size, split, and root directory path
filter_habitat_scenes: filter Habitat dataset scenes by label and optional instance to narrow down selected scenes
get_stereo_views: get two random stereo views from a Habitat scene with images, depthmaps, and camera poses
load_single_view: load a single Habitat view including its image, depthmap, intrinsics, and camera pose from disk
run_habitat_visualization: run the Habitat dataset main block to visualize random scene views as 3D point clouds
